# Copilot Instructions

This directory contains instruction files for different technology stacks and project types. These files provide guidelines, conventions, and best practices for development.

## Instruction Files

- **[typescript-best-practices.md](typescript-best-practices.md)** - General best practices for TypeScript code including Node.js version policy, code simplicity, and type safety.
- **[typescript-node-testing-instructions.md](typescript-node-testing-instructions.md)** - Guidelines for TypeScript projects using Node.js testing framework, Sinon for mocking, and C8 for code coverage reporting.
